verdicts.recomputed: I wrote my own house-exit simulator (v3sim.py, from the ladder.py rules, repo sizing for 30x/20x 'normal', $5,000) and ran it on random samples of 1,500 rows per timeframe (core 15m/1h/4h) and 1,000 rows (DS 15m/4h, with my own Wilder ATR14). Every sampled row matched the lens pickles (leverage 100%, |dR|>1e-3 in 0 rows). My aggregation of the pickles (v3agg.py, week-clustered t) gives core net R 5m -0.307 (t -40.0), 15m -0.172 (-33.4), 30m -0.125 (-28.6), 1h -0.094 (-19.6), 4h -0.051 (-3.8); core gross R +0.0045/+0.0013/-0.0013/+0.0000/+0.0216; DS net -0.177/-0.128/-0.099/-0.066 and gross -0.0036/-0.0041/-0.0057/+0.0062. The tier-walk mean ROE matches out_binance/profiles.json in 175/175 cells (max diff 9.9e-9). Tier-walk R at 15m is -0.1723 and v4n is -0.1717. Total 8.12M signals.
verdicts.note: Reproduces exactly. Small corrections: (a) 'both halves agree to within 0.01R' fails at core 4h (net IS -0.042 vs CF -0.060; gross +0.032 vs +0.011) and only just holds at 30m (0.011). (b) The DS pooled gross is slightly negative, not zero: week-clustered t is -1.8, -1.9 and -2.1 at 15m, 30m and 1h. (c) The pooled 'gross about 0' hides real differences between cells: 18 cells have BH-significant NEGATIVE gross and 4 have positive gross (see F4). The core 4h gross of +0.022 applies only to the 19.7% of signals that pass sizing. verify_costs C2 (all signals at fixed 30x) gives -0.001R at 4h, so it is not robust. Note also that the lens used the Binance signal cache (scratchpad/binance/signals with out_binance profiles). The research/paper_rules signals give different rows.

verdicts.recomputed: Live TRADED replay (v3b+v4) median stop: core 15m 0.63%, 30m 0.89%, 1h 1.23%, 4h 2.02%; DS 0.60/0.85/1.23/1.96%. 5-year net R inside the live p10..p90 stop range: core -0.218/-0.155/-0.107/-0.037; DS -0.244/-0.173/-0.120/-0.079. Core 15m stop quintiles: cost R 0.335/0.194/0.147/0.113/0.077, gross +0.004/+0.008/-0.004/+0.001/-0.002, net -0.331 at stops of 0.63% or less (exact match). Position of the live stop size: per signal, 15m 19.9th, 30m 18.5th, 1h 17.8th, 4h 20.9th percentile (core). In contiguous 5-year windows of the live length (2.2 d core, 1.5 d DS), the live MEAN stop is at the 8.6/7.9/5.0th percentile (core 15m/30m/1h) and 6.4/6.5/5.8th (DS). With window medians: 12.9/8.4/6.8th.
verdicts.note: The hurdle numbers (+0.22/+0.16/+0.11/+0.04R) and the stop-size quintiles reproduce within 0.008R. The claim 'live stop sizes at the 2nd-4th percentile of 5-year windows' does not reproduce. It comes from drawing two independent random windows (0.70 d and 1.50 d), which is too narrow a distribution, and from using 2.2-day windows for DS, which ran only 1.5 days. The correct figure is about the 5th-9th percentile of windows, or the 18th-21st percentile of single signals (consistent with verify_costs C4). The market is quiet, but less extreme than claimed.

verdicts.recomputed: v3win.py: 4,000 contiguous windows per test. Core uses 2.202 d (v3b+v4 are back-to-back: 10/05 01:45Z to 10/07 06:40Z). DS uses 1.503 d (v4 only). Live = replay TRADED mean R. Percentiles: core 15m 0.61, 30m 0.37, 1h 0.33, 4h 0.83; DS 15m 0.90, 30m 0.45, 1h 0.43, 4h 0.39. Stop-matched windows (window mean stop within 15% of the live mean): DS 15m matched median -0.275 and live -0.065, percentile 0.979, two-sided p 0.041 (387 windows). BH across 13 tests gives q of about 0.5. v3a, recomputed with tier-walk R in 2.61-day windows (their live means taken as given): 5m 0.025 (p 0.05; stop-matched 0.11), 15m 0.079, 30m 0.078, 1h 0.76, 4h 0.73. Cell level: |z|>2 in 2/49 core and 2/68 DS cells (2h-cluster SE).
verdicts.note: The substance holds: live sits inside the 5-year distribution, and nothing is significant after correction. However, the tf-level DS test in fy_compare.py (line 344) used RP_LENS = 0.70 d + 1.50 d for DS as well, though DS ran only in v4. That makes the 5-year distribution too narrow and inflates the DS 15m result: the claimed 0.945 (matched 0.995, p 0.009, q 0.12) becomes 0.90 (matched 0.979, p 0.04, q about 0.5). Core used two independent windows rather than one contiguous 2.2-day window. The effect on the percentiles is small (within 0.03).

verdicts.recomputed: v3cells.py, live = replay TRADED v3b+v4, 2h-cluster SE: S4_BB_BBP@15m +0.42 (n 39) vs 5y -0.202 (gross -0.013); N17_KC_RSI@15m +0.11 (n 109) vs -0.160 (gross t -3.35); N20_EMA9_CHOP@30m +0.26 (42) vs -0.150; N20_EMA9_CHOP@1h +0.29 +/-0.10 (17) vs -0.097; N01_ST_EMA@15m +0.16 (30) vs -0.173; DS F1_RSI_DIV@15m +0.45 (18) vs -0.183. Spearman 5y vs live for cells with live n>=10: core -0.097 (49 cells, permutation p 0.51), DS -0.106 (68, p 0.39). v3a was not recomputed.
verdicts.note: Reproduces. Caveat: the 5-year spread between cells within a timeframe (about 0.03R) is far smaller than the live SE per cell (0.1-0.5R). A rank correlation near zero was therefore guaranteed whatever the truth, so this test only shows that live cannot rank cells. It says nothing about whether the 5-year ranks are real.

verdicts.recomputed: Cells with live n>=10: core 11 positive observed vs 12.9 expected at the 5-year average mean (theirs 12.5); DS 26 vs 19.9. z=(live-5y)/SE has sd 1.23 (core) and 1.29 (DS), an exact match. |z|>2 in 2/49 and 2/68 (theirs 3/49 and 4/68; the cluster definition differs).
verdicts.note: The expectation at today's stop size (10.4 / 16.2) was not recomputed. The cells share the same market moments, so the observed-vs-expected count has no simple binomial p-value. The DS excess fits the DS 15m stretch in F3.

verdicts.recomputed: v3grade.py: their class and grade rules applied to my own 5-year cells and live (2h-cluster) table, 15m-4h. B 3 (N23_HA_ST@4h, S1_EMA_RSI_CHOP@1h, F10_M2022@4h), C 54, D 115, F 126, thin 17 (theirs B 3, C 54, D 114, F 127, thin 17). 97% of cells agree; the 9 differences sit at the t=-2 or mu+-2SE edges. The candidate lists reproduce: 15m/30m N01_ST_EMA@15m, N10_HA_PSAR@15m, N24_DMI@30m, F7_RF_TRIPLE@30m/15m, F9_IFVG@15m, F6_VWAP_CROSS@15m, F12_MSS@30m, plus 3 rare Z+ cells; 1h/4h list as in fy_candidates.csv.
verdicts.note: The counts are right, but the method is weak. (1) The grade relies on the live sign, which F5/F6 show is noise. As a result, the cells with the strongest 5-year direction evidence (F16_FIB382@15m and F16_FIB500@15m, both BH-significant and positive in both halves) get D because of 13-18 live trades. F9_FVG@15m (gross t 2.56, both halves) is left out. N10_HA_PSAR@15m and N24_DMI@30m are listed as 'best' although their IS gross is negative. (2) A 5-year class 'N+' with t <= -2 plus a positive live sign gets C, the same grade as an untested Z+ cell. (3) The 1h/4h C list consists mostly of low-power 4h cells (n 39-1,416), where t>-2 means a weak test rather than evidence. With 26-36 cells per kind, a few gross t of about 2 are expected by chance (e.g. F15_ORB@4h is +0.041 while F15_ORB@15m is -0.052, t -4.1).

The 15m range starts at 125, not 140. Otherwise it holds. For a paired AI-vs-rule test, the relevant sd is that of the paired difference, which is not estimated here. Clustering raises all of these numbers.

strategy_note_problems: The strategy_notes in resume/lens_fiveyear.json cover only 61 of 80 strategies (136 of 351 cells). The full set exists in lens/fiveyear/out/strategy_notes_grouped.json but was not carried over. The 18 omitted include N17_KC_RSI (the busiest core strategy, about 68 sized signals/day at 15m, with BH-significant NEGATIVE gross at 15m/30m/1h, and one of the F5 'best live' cells), N04_ST_KLINGER (74/day at 15m/30m), DOGE, the F5_BOX/F5_BOX_HTF/F5_BOX_RSI duplicate family, F4_PULL (52/day), F9_OB, OBV_B/OBV_S, V45_AMB, S3_CMO_SANDWICH, S5_DONCHIAN_MFI, N13_3OUTSIDE, N14_ICHI_RSI (thin), N19_FIB_CHOP, F3_BOS_ZONE and F8_VWICK.

Spot check of all 136 cell entries (5-year net, gross, live n and mean, grade) against my tables: the numbers agree within rounding. The one grade difference is F16_FIB500@4h, F (NN) vs my D (Z-), at t of about -2.

The notes give the gross mean but not its t or BH q, except for F16_FIB382 and N23. Readers cannot tell 'about 0' from 'reliably wrong-way'. For example, the F11_RAID/F13_RAID_PD/F11_TSOUP, F17_Z/F17_Z_HL and F15_ORB/F15_ASIA_SWEEP notes do not say their direction is significantly negative.

The live part of each note (rp n, mean+-SE) feeds the grade, although the lens's own F5/F6 show it carries no information. Notes such as 'N+/L++' for N20_EMA9_CHOP@1h (live +0.29+/-0.10, n 17) read as a positive signal.

The F16_FIB382 note says 'best 5y gross edge of all 15m cells'. It does not say that F16_FIB500@15m is also BH-significant, or that the two share only 18% of their signals (3,842 identical of about 21.6k/22.8k), so they are close to independent confirmations of a Fibonacci-retracement edge before costs.
missed: Anti-edges. 18 cells have BH-significant negative gross (week-clustered, 307 cells with n>=200), against 4 positive. Examples: N17_KC_RSI at 15m (t -3.35), 30m (-2.97) and 1h (-3.90); DS F15_ORB@15m (-4.11); F11_RAID@15m (-4.01) and its duplicates F13_RAID_PD/F11_TSOUP@15m; F17_Z and F17_Z_HL at 15m/1h/4h; F15_ASIA_SWEEP at 15m/30m/1h; F11_PO3 at 30m/1h; F1_PVT_DIV@15m; S4_BB_BBP@5m. These definitions should be the last choice for an AI trader. Flipping them gives only +0.02-0.05R of gross, well below the 0.17R cost at 15m.
The DS family has a small but consistent negative direction content at 15m/30m/1h (pooled gross -0.004 to -0.006R, week-clustered t -1.8 to -2.1). Core is at about 0.

Candidate list without the live sign. Ranked on 5-year evidence alone (gross positive in both halves, BH, frequency), the 15m/30m shortlist would be F16_FIB382@15m (gross +0.026, q 0.006, 11.2/day), F16_FIB500@15m (+0.022, q 0.020, 11.8/day), F9_IFVG@15m (+0.016, t 2.6), F9_FVG@15m (+0.017, t 2.56, 18/day), F7_RF_TRIPLE@30m (+0.012, t 2.0, 30/day) and N01_ST_EMA@15m (+0.011, t 1.3, 17/day). Every one is still about -0.14 to -0.17R net. The lens's C list dropped the first two and F9_FVG because of 13-26 live trades.

The 4h numbers describe a stop-selected subset. v4 sizing admits only 19.7% of 4h signals (narrow stops). The core 4h gross of +0.022R (t 1.65) holds for that subset only; verify_costs C2 finds -0.001R for all 4h signals at fixed 30x. '4h only where 20x is executable' in PLAN_ATTACH matches this subset, but the edge is not significant.

The window-length error for DS in fy_compare.py (2.2-day windows for a 1.5-day run), plus the use of two independent windows, overstated both the DS 15m live outlier and the 'quiet regime' percentile (F2/F3).

The research/exitstyle per-cell BH-significant TP gains in candidate cells (N01_ST_EMA@15m tp1R; N24_DMI and N20_EMA9_CHOP at 15m/30m tp1.5R/tp2R) bear directly on those traders' custom values. The lens reported only the pooled result.
The levstop 'sig_pos_bh' cells (N14_ICHI_RSI@15m/1h/4h, N15_KC_AO@4h, DOGE@4h) rest on 1-2 trades. Anyone reading levstop.json should ignore them. The lens did not warn about this.
